Report this article
Noble Ackerson
Published Jun 29, 2024
+ Follow
I recently
asked if folks wanted to hear my take on the Rabbit R1
. I got a few of you interested. I also wanted to give myself at least a week with it, so now, as any old-school product nerd would, let's evaluate my experience with R1 in a structured way.
I'll use my old and trusty
FURPS+ framework
to organize my thoughts about why the device is failing.
The Rabbit R1 is a $199 AI-powered hardware device. It's not a phone because it only connects to services through something they call a LAM, and it's not quite a brick because they promise the AI (Large Action Model) will work soon. It was developed by tech startup Rabbit Inc. and designed by Teenage Enginee
